items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: "When you hear a whistle, you play 'Sassie Paris'."

ctx.x: And everything else was set. So, one of the officers, he said, "You can have -- take a dressing room, you can relax in your dressing room, but at 8:00 be ready, dressed and everything else." So, we relaxed, and at 8:00, we were ready to -- tuned our horns and everything else. We still didn't know what's happening. So, at 8:00 o'clock, they had given us refreshments, and at 9:00 o'clock, nothing happened. I'd say about 9:30, an officer came and he said, "Take your seats, get ready to play." He said, "I want you to…
Yeh. So he said, "We're looking at you." We don't know what to think of -- I'm so nervous 'cause I'm living through what happened. We didn't know what to do, looking
